target_customer: Insurance agents, brokers and employers managing employee benefits in India
problem: Insurance intermediaries in India lack technology to sell and manage employee health and benefit policies.
business_model: B2B SaaS and distribution platform for insurance intermediaries

founders.name: Kunal Popat
previous_startups: Insurance brokerage scaled to $3M revenue per YC page

competitors.name: Pazcare
competitors.what: Employee health benefits platform in India

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrations with insurers and TPAs plus agent tools; moderate engineering with integration effort.

defensibility.rationale: Insurer integrations take effort but competing platforms exist.

market_need_then: The YC page says agents are India's largest insurance distribution channel and many products are underserved; no dated data on spend was found.

branding.name_origin: The company began as InsureMyTeam (insuremyteam.com); IMT is the acronym; the rename date and reason are not sourced
branding.domain_note: Operated at insuremyteam.com earlier; imt.care now

identity.voice_and_tone: Promotional and growth-focused; Technologically Empowering Insurance Intermediaries

brand_strength.rationale: Acronym name with no sourced brand presence.

pivots.from: InsureMyTeam, employee health benefits for companies
pivots.to: IMT Care, technology for insurance intermediaries
pivots.why: Inferred from the YC page and site positioning; no source states a pivot

outcome_analysis: IMT Care is listed as Active with a team of 23 and says it has an insurance technology platform for intermediaries. No funding beyond an unverified $500K YC note, no exit and no layoffs were found. Revenue figures online conflict and are unverified, so traction cannot be judged.
notes: CB Insights lists a $500K YC convertible note dated 2022-01-01; Tracxn is reported as showing no funding; aggregator only, not recorded as a round. Revenue claims ($3.5M for 2024 vs INR 1.34 crore) conflict and are unverified. The Insurtech Partner of the Year 2023 award is a company claim. Pazcare is dated by an aggregator comparison page. Founder education not found.
